_comment: COMBINATION BOOK, DRY RUN (founder 2026-10-11: 'yes' to forward-testing research ledger C1). One unit per daily signal that is on at the prior close — weak close (IBS<=0.3 or close below the session-before low) with VIX>=20; big down day (body <= -1 ATR); wide down day (range >= 1.5 ATR, closed down) — buy the 09:30 ET open, sell 15:55 (flat by the close, legal on Tradeify). 1-3 MES on ES ticks. Chosen on 2010-18, scored 2019-26: PF 1.70, 8/8 years. No stop (every stop lowers the edge; sl_points 1000 = none). dry_run: no orders, label tradeify_combo_dry. NQ twin: tradeify_combo.
